title: Baby Sleep Pattern and Longest Stretch
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=baby:sleep
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(duration_min) as total_min, max(duration_min) as longest by _time
| eval total_h=round(total_min/60,1), longest_h=round(longest/60,1)
| sort - _time
description: Trends how much a baby slept each day and the longest unbroken stretch, the number every exhausted parent watches most.
value: The longest sleep stretch is the truest sign of progress toward sleeping through; trending it turns hope into visible improvement.
implementation: Log sleep sessions to `index=personal`; schedule daily and review total sleep and the longest stretch.
visualization: Line chart of daily total sleep with the longest stretch.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much the baby slept and the longest they went without waking, which every tired parent watches closely.
